================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO OO LOOGU TALAGALAY AFTER EFFECTS - WAXA CUSUB
Nooca 9.2.9  -  Oktoobar 2026
================================================================================

33 MAWDUUC ANIME oo cusub ayaa ku biiray kuwa Demon Slayer, saameynta jiirka ee
mawduucyadu hadda si dhab ah ayay uga muuqataa gudaha After Effects, Doorashada
Mawduucana waxay noqotay hal liis hoos-u-dhac ah oo habaysan.

INTA AAN LA BILAABIN
- Ku rakib nooca aad hadda haysato adigoo isticmaalaya rakibaha ZXP ee aad caadiga u
  isticmaasho, ka dibna hal mar dib u bilow After Effects.
- Dejinnadaada, mawduucaaga, presets-kaaga iyo expressions-ka aad kaydisay waa la
  hayaa.

CUSUB: 33 MAWDUUC ANIME
- Dejinnada Flex > DOORASHADA MAWDUUCA > MAWDUUCA PANEL-KA hadda waxay leeyihiin koox
  gaar ah anime kasta:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan (Okarun),
  Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter
  x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba
  (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto
  (Itachi, Minato), One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero
  (Rem), Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) iyo Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Jilaa kastaa wuxuu leeyahay muuqaal u gaar ah: waxa raacaya jiirkaaga, weerarka
  marka aad gujiso badhan, waxa dhaca inta aad haysato badhanka bidix, iyo qaraxa ka
  dib markaad hayso qiyaastii 2.5 ilbiriqsi.
- Sida mawduucyada Demon Slayer oo kale ayay u fudud yihiin: saameynadu waxay
  shaqeeyaan oo keliya marka aad dhaqaajiso jiirka ama aad gujiso. Dami EFFECT-YADA
  HAWADA haddii aad rabto midabada oo keliya.

LA BEDDELAY: DOORASHADA MAWDUUCA
- Kaararka Demon Slayer ee ka hooseeyay MAWDUUCA PANEL-KA waa la saaray, sidaas
  darteed Dejinnada Flex way gaabteen. Mawduuc kasta ka dooro liiska hoos-u-dhaca
  MAWDUUCA PANEL-KA; wuxuu ku furmaa mawduuca aad hadda isticmaalayso.
- Kurama iyo Baryon hadda waxay ku jiraan kooxda Naruto.

LA HAGAAJIYAY
- Saameynta jiirka ee mawduucyada (biyo, olol, hillaac iyo inta kale) inta badan kama
  muuqan jirin gudaha After Effects, xitaa marka Qaabka Hagaajinta uu damsanaa.
  Daqiiqadaha uu guddigu laftiisu mashquulka yahay iyo bilow culus ayaa loo qaadan
  jiray in mawduucu gaabinayo, sidaas darteed saameynadu iskood ayay u dami jireen.
  Hadda, marka kaarka garaafikadaadu sawiro (kombiyuutarada intooda badan),
  daqiiqadahaas waxay saameynada ka dhigaan kuwo fudud muddo yar oo keliya.

LAMA BEDDELIN
- Shatiyeynta, hawlgelinta iyo isku-xir kasta waxay u shaqeeyaan sidii hore oo kale.
- 11-ka mawduuc ee Demon Slayer waxay u muuqdaan sidii ay ahaayeen gudaha 9.2.8.
- Tab kasta oo kale iyo qalab kasta waxay u shaqeeyaan sidii gudaha 9.2.8.
================================================================================

  shidan.
